title: Enhancing public health infectious disease response through the Australian Pathogen Genomics program (AusPathoGen): evaluation protocol
organization: Ferdinand et al. / Frontiers in Public Health
description: Evaluation protocol for the Australian Pathogen Genomics program, describing methods to assess the public health utility, implementation, costs, and decision-making value of whole genome sequencing.
keyFeatures: Mixed-methods evaluation protocol for a national pathogen genomics program.
Includes situation assessment, case studies, expert elicitation, and economic evaluation.
Focuses on utility of genomics for public health decision-making.
Can inform evaluation designs for other genomic surveillance programs.
practicalUse: Use this protocol as a model for evaluating genomic surveillance programs, including utility, implementation barriers, costs, and impact on public health response.
